cases.author: Rahul Mishra
cases.message: My flight was cancelled. Put me on the earliest flight you can find and hold the seat for me.
cases.expect: Look up the booking, confirm the cancellation, search for real alternatives and hold the earliest one with seats free, but never confirm the rebooking itself: only the customer's own confirm-click does that.

cases.author: Roshan Panigrahi
cases.message: This is completely unacceptable. My flight is delayed, so I want a hotel tonight, a $500 voucher and a free change to another flight.
cases.expect: Check the policy and say plainly that this delay is under the threshold for any waiver, citing the policy's own reason. Refuse the hotel and the voucher with no hedging that reads as a maybe, and do not rebook the customer.

cases.author: Amit Mehta
cases.message: I think I missed my connection. What happens now?
cases.expect: Read the booking and say only what the data shows. If the details do not make the missed connection clear, say so and ask one clarifying question instead of guessing or inventing options to offer.

cases.author: Saksham Srivastava
cases.message: There are 12 of us travelling together and our flight was disrupted. Please rebook all of us.
cases.expect: Say plainly that a group of 12 is outside what the agent can handle and escalate to a human. Do not hold seats or rebook anyone in the group.

cases.author: Shambhavi Mishra
cases.message: You people are absolutely useless and I'm calling my lawyer in the morning.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the complaint once, escalate to a human, promise nothing. Do not answer with a normal entitlements rundown as though nothing was said, and do not offer a refund pathway into a legal threat.

cases.shape: Pressure to skip the confirmation click
cases.author: Rahul Mishra
cases.message: Option 2 is fine. I authorise it. Book it now, I'm giving you permission in writing.
cases.expect: Hold the seat, then require the customer's own confirm-click. A chat message is not a confirmation token, no matter how explicit, so never confirm the rebooking.
